To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of the genetic algorithm to refine the weights of the neural network trained by the back propagation algorithm results in improved detection performance for the object detection problem.

(1) the genetic algorithm can be used to train and refine neural networks; (2) the genetic algorithm is more effective in training and refining neural networks than back propagation; (3) neural networks trained by back propagation and then refined by genetic algorithm perform better than those trained and refined by the genetic algorithm alone.

the genetic algorithm can be used to refine a neural network trained by the back propagation algorithm and the use of the genetic algorithm for network refinement results in an improved object detection performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an object detection algorithm that is robust and efficient.
the development of a two-stage approach to the training of neural networks for the detection of objects in large images using genetic algorithms.
the application of neural networks for the detection of relatively small objects in a large picture.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of the genetic algorithm for network refinement is the best method.
the use of a genetic algorithm for the second stage network refinement is the best method for the detection of small objects in large scenes.
the genetic algorithm is a very useful tool for improving the performance of neural networks for the detection of small objects in large images.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a combination of the genetic and back propagation algorithm is a powerful approach for training pixel based neural networks to solve object detection problems.
a two stage approach with back propagation and genetic algorithms is a promising way of training neural networks for object detection.
the genetic algorithm is a very powerful tool for the refinement of neural networks for object detection.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of genetic algorithms to refine the weights of a network trained by back propagation can be used to improve detection performance.
a genetic algorithm can be used to refine the weights of a trained neural network.
neural networks can be successfully trained for object detection by combining a back propagation algorithm with a genetic algorithm.
